title: Spindle Motor Temperature — Elevated
description: Spindle motor temperature P003 = {val} °C. Within normal range but {val2} °C above 30-day average for same duty cycle.
probable_cause: Slight cooling degradation or increased duty cycle.
diagnostic_steps: Verify coolant flow to motor if liquid-cooled
remedy: Clean filters at next shift break. Monitor trend.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
escalation_path: If SPN-MN-002 is not addressed (log fault. monitor parameters. schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-MJ-001, then THM-WN-070. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
